title: onobrychis peduncularis subsp. jahandiezii
intro: Onobrychis peduncularis subsp. jahandiezii, commonly known as a plant species within the legume family, is a type of wild sainfoin. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant health benefits. The therapeutic actions of O. peduncularis subsp. jahandiezii include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight against free radicals, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
